_metadata.description: Go CLI exposing components, adoptions, and versions verbs against the local API per cli-steer conventions.

requirements.title: `react-component-library` provides components, adoptions, versions, themes subcommand trees
requirements.description: Subcommand groups: `components {list,get,search,index,content get|set}`, `adoptions {list,create,refresh,preview}`, `versions {list,show}`, `themes {builtin list|show, from-scenario}`. Each verb prints default human-readable output and accepts `--json` to switch to machine-readable per `cli-steer`.

validation.notes: Per-domain CLI tests invoke the built binary against a stub API and assert exit code + parseable output.

requirements.title: CLI exits non-zero on API errors with a single-line human message
requirements.description: On 4xx/5xx, the CLI prints `Error: <message>` to stderr and exits with the documented exit codes (2 for client errors, 3 for server errors, 4 for transport errors). `--json` prints a structured error object instead.

validation.notes: CLI test stubs the API to return 400/500/connection-refused and asserts exit code + output.

requirements.title: CLI auto-discovers the local API port via the lifecycle metadata
requirements.description: Without explicit `--api-base`, the CLI resolves the API port from `vrooli scenario port react-component-library API_PORT` (or the equivalent registry call). Explicit `--api-base` overrides.

validation.notes: CLI test mocks lifecycle resolution and asserts the resolved URL.
